name: Touch of Purity
body:
You are especially dedicated to your god’s teachings and are extremely difficult to subvert even with the use of magic.

Prerequisite(s): 7th-level cleric, Wisdom 15 or Greater

Benefit: If you are the subject of any kind of charm or compulsion spell or spell-like ability that would make you either act against your alignment or against followers of your own god you may make two saving throws and choose the highest one.
